items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: he had a saxophone player in his band who I think we might say had a little name, Gene Ammons, Jug.

ctx.x: like Dizz Gillespie was playing in Teddy Hill's band, and Cab Calloway for a period of time, and Billy Eckstine had one of the great, really, jazz bands for a short period of time at that time.

You know, I was going to say that. You know, Billy had a great jazz band, and he played out in Los Angeles at a club, what we talked about earlier, called the Plantation, out at 108th and Central Avenue, and he had a saxophone player in his band who I think we might say had a little name, Gene Ammons, Jug.
